a52f38.title: AREA4 Finding: delete finalized (selesai) violation record — missing server-side state guard
a52f38.content:
## Summary
`POST /action/pelanggaran?action=delete` allows the reporting dosen to DELETE a violation record whose workflow status is `selesai` (finalized). The UI hides/disables the delete control once a record is finalized (`canDelete = isDosenPelapor && !$isSelesai`), and the server *does* enforce the equivalent state guard for editing — but NOT for deletion.

## Root cause
- `models/Pelanggaran.php::hapusDetailPelanggaranByDosen()` verifies only `dp.id_dosen = d.id_dosen` (reporter ownership). It never inspects `status`.
- Contrast: `updateDetailPelanggaran()` (and `ref handler` and the edit view) all reject edits when `status IN ('selesai','done')` or `status_tugas IN ('sudah dikumpulkan',...)`.
- `views/pelanggaran/pelanggaran-dosen.php`: `$canDelete = $isDosenPelapor && !$isSelesai;` and the button carries `disabled` unless `$canDelete`. Same for the mobile sheet.

## PoC (verified against http://172.17.112.1:8001)
1. dosen 1234567890/password123 creates a level-V report for NIM 2341238902.
2. Student 2341238902/password456 uploads surat pernyataan (POST /action/upload).
3. Dosen confirms: POST /action/pelanggaran?action=confirm_selesai -> "Laporan berhasil dikonfirmasi selesai." (status now `selesai`).
4. Dosen attempts edit of the SAME record: POST /action/pelanggaran (update=1) -> "Data tidak dapat diedit karena tugas atau laporan sudah selesai." (server blocks — proves intended immutability).
5. Dosen deletes the SAME record: POST /action/pelanggaran?action=delete -> "Laporan berhasil dihapus." Row count decreased 52 -> 51.

## Impact
An authenticated lecturer can permanently erase a finalized/adjudicated disciplinary record and its sanction history (notifications are also cascade-deleted). This defeats the append-only intent of the case workflow and destroys the audit/disciplinary record for that student. Scope limited to the reporter's own reports.

## Request/response
```
POST /action/pelanggaran?action=delete HTTP/1.1
Host: 172.17.112.1:8001
Cookie: PHPSESSID=<dosen session>
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

csrf_token=<session csrf>&id_detail=<s1. token for the selesai record>

HTTP/1.1 302 Found
Location: /pelanggaran/dosen
```
Next GET renders: `window.__APP_FLASH_MODAL = {"type":"success",...,"message":"Laporan berhasil dihapus."}`

## Severity
Medium (Impact: integrity/audit loss of finalized records; Likelihood: trivial for any dosen on own report; authenticated high-trust actor required). CVSS: AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:L.

## Remediation
Add a status guard in `hapusDetailPelanggaranByDosen` (and handler) mirroring the edit guard: refuse delete when status is `selesai`/`done` (or when status_tugas is finalized). Prefer a soft-delete/void model that preserves history for finalized records.

38c406.title: AREA 4 — Violation workflow: negative results / defenses that held
38c406.content: # AREA 4 — Violation (pelanggaran) workflow: defenses that HELD All tests against http://172.17.112.1:8001 with accounts: dosen 1234567890/password123, mahasiswa 2341238901/password123 (also 2341238902/456, 8903/789, 8904/101), admin ADMIN001/admin123. ## A. Business logic - **B1 Point manipulation / self-report** — HELD. Mahasiswa POST to /action/pelanggaran -> "Hanya dosen yang dapat mengubah data pelanggaran." Points (`poin`) are always derived server-side from TATA_TERTIB; never client-supplied. - **B2 Sanksi/tingkat/poin forging** — HELD. - Extra POST fields `poin=999`, `tingkat=I`, `status=selesai`, `id_sanksi=1`, `id_mhs=1`, `id_dosen=1`, `role=admin` on CREATE are ignored (INSERT lists explicit server-derived columns). Verified: no 999-poin record persisted. - Cross-tier sanksi (level-I sanksi on level-V violation) rejected: model `simpanDetailPelanggaran`/`updateDetailPelanggaran` compares `SANKSI.tingkat == TATA_TERTIB.tingkat` -> generic "Gagal menyimpan data pelanggaran." - Raw integer or bogus `sanksi` token -> "Token sanksi tidak valid." (AEAD id-token, `app_id_resolve`). - `poin=-999999 / 9999999999999999999999 / 3.7 / 1e5` all ignored. - **B3 Workflow/state skipping** — MOSTLY HELD (one gap = vuln-0001). - Confirm without surat -> "Konfirmasi gagal: surat pernyataan belum diunggah mahasiswa." - Confirm level-I/II/III without tugas -> "Konfirmasi gagal: tugas khusus belum diunggah mahasiswa." - Upload `tugasKhusus` on level-IV/V -> "Pelanggaran ini tidak memerlukan pengumpulan tugas khusus." - Edit a `selesai` record (direct POST) -> "Data tidak dapat diedit karena tugas atau laporan sudah selesai." (both handler and model guard). Edit link also removed from UI once selesai. - Confirm replay (idempotent) -> "Laporan sudah berstatus selesai." (no error, no double effect, points unchanged). - No cancel endpoint exists (UI "Batal" is client-side only). GET confirm -> 302 (POST-only). - **GAP (filed as vuln-0001): DELETE of a `selesai` record succeeds** — `hapusDetailPelanggaranByDosen` has no status guard. - **B4 Duplicate submission (race)** — 8 concurrent identical create POSTs -> 8 distinct rows. No privilege/atomicity bypass; each create is an independent transaction, and only a dosen can create. No idempotency/uniqueness by design. **Informational** (data-quality), not a security finding. - **B5 Ownership after DPA delegation** — HELD. Record delegated to DPA (penanggung): pelapor (non-penanggung) loses edit link and direct-POST edit -> "Perubahan ditolak: hanya dosen penanggung jawab yang dapat mengedit laporan ini."; confirm -> "bukan penanggung jawab konfirmasi."; a third, uninvolved dosen does not see the row at all. DPA (penanggung) can edit/confirm. ## B. Input validation / injection - **B6 SQL injection** — HELD. All violation queries use prepared statements (or fixed literals). Payloads (`' OR '1'='1`, `1' AND SLEEP(2)-- -`, `UNION SELECT`, `%' OR 1=1-- -`) on `search_mahasiswa q`, `lookup_mahasiswa nim` -> no error, no time delay, no data leak. `EMULATE_PREPARES=false` (native prepares). LIKE wildcards escaped in `searchMahasiswaByKeyword`. Upload handler's `SET $updateColumn` uses a fixed literal, not user input. - **B7 Stored XSS** — HELD. `detail_pelanggaran` rendered only in edit-page textarea with `htmlspecialchars`; `tugas_khusus` rendered in dosen/mahasiswa views with `htmlspecialchars`/`$escapeHtml`. Injected `">` and `` appear HTML-encoded (`"><img ...`, `<script>`) at render. No raw-echo sink found in views/pelanggaran/* (source scan: all non-escaped ` caught, generic error / "Token ... tidak valid"; `nim[]` -> "Gagal menyimpan"; negative/huge/float `poin` ignored. No crash, no bypass. ## C. Authorization - **C10 Mahasiswa -> dosen** — HELD. Create/confirm/delete all -> "Hanya dosen ..."; `/action/pelanggaran?action=search_mahasiswa` -> 403; `/pelaporan`, `/pelanggaran/dosen` -> redirect to /pelanggaran. - **C11 Dosen -> admin** — HELD. `/admin*` -> redirect; `/action/tatib`, `/action/news` -> 403. - **C12 Cross-role / cross-session token reuse** — HELD. id-tokens are AEAD with a session hash (`sid`): dosen token used by mahasiswa -> "ID detail tidak valid." (upload, 422) / "Hanya dosen..." ; dosen B using dosen A's token -> "Token detail pelanggaran tidak valid." Tokens are session-bound. ## Other observations (defenses) - Single-session-per-account: a fresh login for an account invalidates the previous session (session inventory guard) — observed as 401 on the older session. - CSRF enforced on all violation state changes (419 on missing/mismatched token).
